# KimRosil App Studio

> 100% offline-first, privacy-centric native Android utilities engineered for maximum performance, zero telemetry, and micro footprint.

KimRosil App Studio (founded by Eliakim Rosil) is an independent Android software development studio specializing in domain-tailored, pure native utilities for Android. Every application in the portfolio is engineered with standard Android framework components in Java and Kotlin + XML, compiled natively on ARM64 Snapdragon hardware, and distributed as standalone freeware APKs.

## Key Architecture & Philosophy
- **100% Offline-First by Design**: All algorithms, databases, timers, calculations, and audio generation run locally on-device. Zero network requests required.
- **Zero Data Collection**: No user tracking, no device fingerprinting, no background analytics, and no advertising SDKs.
- **Pure Native Framework Performance**: Built with standard Android framework components in Java + XML and Kotlin + XML, eliminating web wrappers, React Native, or heavy bloated runtimes (<5 MB APKs).
- **Direct Distribution**: Fast, clean downloads via official GitHub Releases CDN alongside Google Play closed beta tracks.
